description: This file defines the CreateValue class, a method operation for the mini-language in the OFBiz framework, implementing the <create-value> element to create or store a GenericValue object.

classes.name: CreateValue
classes.description: A method operation class that implements the <create-value> element, responsible for creating or storing a GenericValue based on XML configuration.

classes.name: CreateValueFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of CreateValue from XML elements.

methods.name: CreateValue
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the CreateValue object based on XML element attributes.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the create or store operation for the specified GenericValue within the method context.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the CreateValue object.
